sloka: नूनम् तु बलवान् लोके कृतान्तः सर्वमादिशन् ।लोके रामाभिरामस्त्वम् वनम् यत्र गमिष्यसि ॥२-२४-५॥
transliteration: nūnam tu balavān loke kṛtāntaḥ sarvamādiśan ।loke rāmābhirāmastvam vanam yatra gamiṣyasi ॥2-24-5॥

translations.english: O Rama if you, being the delight of the world, are (ordered) to go to the forest, it has to be said certainly that destiny which rules everything is allpowerful.
